_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround e na {width}x{height} grid.
O iko na player {player_id}. Valid moves: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' se w/s/a/d.
Objective: moce cake sara ga na tamata kece. Na trails deadly; wall hits kill; head-on crashes kill rau.

board.current: Tabana ni veiqaravi ena gauna oqo: {board}
board.after_moves: Na papa ni oti na toso vata: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Player {player_id} died due to invalid move.

outcome.survived_win: E bula na dauqito {player_id}; era a lutu kece.
outcome.all_crashed: Era lutu kece na dauqito ena dua ga na gauna.
outcome.outlived: E bula balavu duadua o koya e dau qito.
outcome.turn_limit: Sa yacova na iyalayala ni gauna me vuki kina - sa qaqa o koya e bula dede duadua.
